title: Starfall Meadow
intro: A small, dreamy world filled with little moments waiting to be discovered.

memories.title: First Glances
memories.description: School corridors, crisp uniforms, and the very first hellos.
memories.alt: Illustration of two students meeting in a busy school corridor.

memories.title: City Lights, New Faces
memories.description: An evening in the city, a bucket hat, and a crowd of friends.
memories.alt: Illustration of a girl in a bucket hat walking a city street at dusk with friends.

memories.title: Goodnight Texts
memories.description: Two screens glowing late into the night.
memories.alt: Split illustration of two people texting each other from their beds at night.

memories.title: Wandering the Mall
memories.description: Escalators, shop windows, and no particular plan.
memories.alt: Illustration of three friends standing together inside a shopping mall.

memories.title: Pizza for Two
memories.description: A shared pizza and two cold drinks.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people sitting across a table sharing a pizza.

memories.title: Scooter Rides at Sunset
memories.description: Warm wind and a golden road.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people riding a scooter down a tree-lined road at sunset.

memories.title: By the Water
memories.description: A quiet afternoon at the water's edge.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people smiling beside a lake in soft afternoon light.

memories.title: Snacks at Priti Corner
memories.alt: Illustration of two people laughing and eating snacks outside a shop called Priti Corner.

memories.title: Apart, but Together
memories.alt: Split illustration of two people at home messaging each other, one wearing a face mask.

memories.title: A Grid of Smiles
memories.description: Video calls full of funny faces.
memories.alt: Grid of video-call frames showing a smiling girl with glasses in many poses.

memories.title: Dinner Glow
memories.description: A warm evening out, glass raised.
memories.alt: Illustration of a woman raising a glass at a cosy restaurant table with grilled food.

memories.title: Beachside Café
memories.description: Palm leaves, sea breeze, and a slow lunch.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people at a beachside café table overlooking the sea.

memories.title: Hugs on the Shore
memories.description: A silly hat and the biggest hug.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people hugging on a beach, one wearing a frog hat.

memories.title: Fort Selfie
memories.description: Old stone walls, blue water, big grins.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people taking a selfie in front of a seaside fort.

memories.title: Sandy Toes with Friends
memories.description: Friends, sand, and a golden afternoon.
memories.alt: Illustration of four friends sitting together on a sandy beach.

memories.title: Walking the Sunset
memories.description: Hand in hand along the shoreline.
memories.alt: Illustration of two people walking hand in hand on a beach at sunset.

memories.title: Watching the Waves
memories.alt: Illustration of two people seen from behind, standing in the shallows watching a sunset.

memories.title: Side by Side
memories.alt: Illustration of two people sitting close together at home, smiling.

milestones.title: The meadow is waking up
milestones.message: Fireflies have come out to light your way.

milestones.title: Something is blooming
milestones.message: A wishing tree has grown at the heart of the meadow.

milestones.title: Every journey holds a memory
milestones.message: You found every memory. Look up — the stars are falling for you.
